mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 doesn't increase over next 5 quarters or 20-day returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced inflationary pressure easing financial uncertainty.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL doesn't decline over next 6 months or returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly UNRATE decline below 4.0% triggers positive 20-day S&P returns due to stronger labor market confidence and consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the regime is not late-cycle expansion or UNRATE doesn't fall below 4.0% when it should, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE drop below 4.0% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns due to immediate labor market strength spurring short-term confidence.
failure_condition: If the trigger doesn't occur or returns are negative within the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly FEDFUNDS rise above 4.5% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to anticipated rate hikes increasing borrowing costs.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS doesn't cross threshold or returns are positive when it does.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO rise above 105 triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns due to stronger production capacity and potential for sustained growth.
failure_condition: If INDPRO doesn't cross threshold or returns are negative over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to expectations of lower inflation and stronger labor demand boosting growth.
failure_condition: If the interaction doesn't occur or returns are negative when it does.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly rise in GDPC1 and monthly rise in INDPRO triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns due to robust demand and supply growth driving short-term profits.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 ↑ from prior quarter and INDPRO ↑ from prior month
failure_condition: If both proxies don't rise together or returns are negative within 5 days.
